notes.title: The whole droid page at a glance
notes.summary: Every quality in one table, your Droidex marked on it, fusion recipes, and a fusion rule put right.
changes: A droid's page now lists every quality in one table, so you can compare them without clicking between them.
The quality you are looking at stays put. It used to drop back to Default whenever you switched to the game and came back.
Qualities already in your Droidex are ticked on the table and marked on the tabs, with a line saying how many are left and which.
A fusion droid's page now shows its recipe: the three droids it is made from, green when you already hold enough.
The Roster is in alphabetical order.
Three of the same droid at Stellar now correctly make a random droid one rarity up, at Stellar. Stellar has no quality above it, so they were being treated as a dead end.
B1 HEAVY at Stellar earns 48K/s, not the 50.4K it was showing.

notes.title: Add and upgrade droids straight from the needed lists
notes.summary: Buttons on every requirement card, sell and upgrade hints, rebirth rewards on the headings, and D-O.
changes: Added an Add button to every card in "Needed later" and on the Rebirth page.
Once you own the droid that button becomes the change quality button.
Added a green $ to cards for droids that nothing after that rebirth needs.
Cards now say when a later rebirth wants a higher quality, such as "Beskar → Galactic later".
Added a "What is still left" panel to the Base: each outstanding droid listed once at its highest needed quality, plus the droids in your Base that nothing needs any more.
Rebirth headings now show the Nova Crystals, credit multiplier and crit perk you get for reaching them.
Added the rebirth crit perks: +5% crit chance at 23, 26 and 29, and +10% crit amount at 24, 27 and 30. They stack and the Critical Calculator counts them.
Added a floating rebirth bar to the Base that appears once the settings box scrolls out of view.
Hold Ctrl while dragging a droid to copy it into an empty slot instead of moving it.
Added a Max rebirth setting to the Rebirth page.
Not using Base now summarises the droids you have ticked, what they cost to upgrade for later rebirths, and which are safe to sell.
Added D-O, the Iconic worker from the D-O Event: 15%/s, Half Fusion Time. No portrait yet.

notes.title: A tidier Base, a fuller Fusion Outlook, and the D-O Event
notes.summary: Ten small things: duplicates counted once, the fusion panels given room, and two events put right.
changes: The Roster counts duplicates. Two of the same droid at the same quality are one card with a count instead of two entries. The remove button takes one copy off.
The fusion note in the droid picker is much smaller and no longer swallows the card, and it can be switched off.
Optimise settings is now Advanced settings, and the switch for that fusion note lives there.
The timer clock sits centred when the strip shrinks on scroll.
Base multiplier and Current rebirth have up and down arrows beside the box, so nothing is cut off.
The buttons on a droid's page are one tidy row instead of a scattered line.
Fusion Outlook lists every droid you could use rather than stopping at five and saying "+2 more".
Fusion Outlook rows expand, showing each droid's portrait, the quality you hold it at, and the slot it is standing in.
The DJ R3X mini event's morning run moved to 10am Eastern. The evening run is unchanged.
Added the D-O Event, opening on 29 August for 24 hours.

notes.title: The Fusion room, a DJ Event timer, and one account everywhere
notes.summary: Droid Fusion is in: seventeen new droids, a Fusion Lab that tracks what you are building towards, and a Base that fuses them. Plus a timer for the weekly dance party and live sync between your browser and the companion.
changes: Fusion Lab, a new page. Every confirmed combination is there: three droids in, one out. It shows how many of each ingredient you hold against how many the recipe wants, so a recipe wanting two of the same droid tells you whether you have both, not just one.
Seventeen fusion droids added to the archive with their income and value for every quality, and a Droidex square each. They take one square rather than seven because they cannot be upgraded yet.
Track the results you are working towards in the Fusion Lab, and a Fusion Outlook appears on your Base listing what each one still needs and which are ready to fuse.
The droid picker now says what each droid fuses into and what else that recipe wants, in green where you already hold it — so choosing what to put in a Fusion slot does not mean going to look it up.
Six new Base slots from Rebirth 3: three Fusion slots and three Fusion Build slots. The first Fusion Build slot comes with the room, the second with Fusion Tank 1 and the third with Fusion Tank 2.
A Fuse button on the Fusion station. It spends the three droids and puts the result into a free Fusion Build slot, which then builds the way any Build slot does.

Fusing a combination nobody has recorded asks what came out, and every fusion is logged. The Fusion Lab shows what each combination has produced and how often, so the numbers build up as people use it.
Nova Shop: Fusion Tank 1 and 2 at 300 Nova Crystals each, and Fusion Speed, which adds +1/sec of Droid Fusion per level and runs to level 50.
Cantina Shop: a Fusion Pack, and Fusion Tank 2 on its own for 800 V-Bucks.
DJ Event timer for the weekly dance party at the Sandcrawler, beside Stellar, Mythic and Galactic. It counts down in days, hours and minutes, and counts out the window while the event is running.
Signing in on one device now reaches the other. A change made in your browser shows up in the companion within a second, and the other way round, instead of waiting for a reload.
The companion's spawn alerts can check every profile you have, not just the one loaded — your own and any shared with you through a group — and say which of them needs the droid.
Droidex need-hints in the companion: when a spawn alerts, it says which of your profiles are still missing that exact quality.

notes.title: Battle floors, and a shorter walk round the Base
notes.summary: Optimise knows which Battle slot the game will use, says which floor it is on, and walks you round in a tighter loop.
changes: Optimise now knows how the game picks a Battle slot. A free downstairs slot is always taken before an upstairs one, and among the upstairs slots it works back from the stairs, so Battle 11 goes before Battle 6. It used to assume the lowest slot number always won, which was wrong upstairs.

Anywhere a Battle slot is named now says which floor it is on, because the number alone does not tell you where to walk. That covers the step-by-step moves, the classic plan, the "From:" line in the Optimise preview, the Rebirth outlook and the needed list on Base.

Optimise now uses the real positions from the Base map to order your walk. Where two stations have the same amount to do it sends you to the nearer one, which on our test bases cut the walking by about 8% and by a quarter on the worst one.

Because Build slot 1 sits by the Worker ring, slot 2 in the Astromech room and slot 3 in the Battle room, Build now lands next to whichever room you are already in rather than sending you back across the Base.

notes.title: Astromech mission slots, and clearer cycle requirements
notes.summary: Optimise now stocks the mission slots on purpose, and the needed list tells you the cost and where the droid is.
changes: Optimise now treats Astromech slots 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 as the mission slots they are. R2-D2 takes one first because it comes back with two rewards, then CB-23 because it opens a mission nothing else reaches, then the other Astromech Iconics for their mission times, then simply the best Astromechs you own.

Optimise picks the best droid in your whole roster for each mission slot, so anything already sitting in one that is not the best choice gets moved out or sold as usual. Only the droid it picks is then protected from being sold or lounged, and the preview says which slot it is holding and why.
Locked droids and your own Companion and Upgrade Chip picks still come first, so nothing you chose yourself gets taken for a mission slot.

"Needed later in this cycle" now works like the Rebirth outlook. If you own the droid but not at the right quality it turns amber instead of red, tells you how many chips the upgrade costs, and says which slot the copy is sitting in.
Both of these work in the legacy interface as well as the modern one.

notes.title: Optimise always gives you a route now
notes.summary: The "could not route" message is gone, and the account button no longer overlaps the menu.
changes: Fixed Optimise refusing to route droids on a full Base. It would only ever tell you things the game does for you, so if a droid needed to end up somewhere "go to work" would not send it, there was nothing it could say and it gave up. Sell Priority made no difference because that was never the problem.

This happens most often when a droid needs to move to a station that is not its own type. Sending it to work would just put it back in its own station, so Optimise now tells you to carry it across yourself, the same as the classic plan does.
The old message also suggested freeing a credit slot, which made it worse rather than better. A free slot in a droid's own station is exactly what pulls it back there.
Fixed the account button in the legacy interface spilling your profile name over the top menu.

notes.title: Map slots now unlock in the right order
notes.summary: Every spot on the map is tied to the Rebirth that actually unlocks it.
changes: Each dot on the map is now the slot it really is. Before, the spots were listed in the order they appear on the floor rather than the order the game unlocks them, so a marker could show the wrong Rebirth and the wrong droid could sit on it.
Hovering a locked spot tells you the Rebirth that opens it, and spots you have already reached but not bought are picked out so you can see what is waiting for you.
Build slots were wrong everywhere, not just on the map: the Base gave you all three from the start. You start with one, and the other two open at Rebirth 1 and Rebirth 2.
The map header no longer counts slots you have not unlocked, so "spots filled" is out of the slots you actually have, with the locked ones listed separately.
This clears the work in progress note from the Base map update.

notes.title: Optimise: swaps through the Companion and chip slots
notes.summary: Optimise no longer gives up when two droids need to trade places.
changes: Fixed Optimise saying "could not route" when one droid needed the Upgrade Chip slot and the droid already in it was wanted as your Companion. Each was holding the slot the other needed, and neither was allowed to move first, so the plan gave up even with the Lounge half empty.

Optimise will now step one of them into the Lounge to break the tie, then finish the swap. It only does this when something is genuinely waiting on that slot, so straightforward plans are the same length as before.

notes.title: Critical Calculator
notes.summary: Work out what your pickaxe actually removes per swing, and which Nova crit upgrade is the best next buy.
changes: Added a Critical Calculator that takes your Critical Chance, Critical Amount, Multi Crit, pickaxe level, Astromech companion and whether you have Chopper, and tells you your average seconds removed per swing.
It ranks the three crit upgrades by how much damage each one buys per Nova Crystal, and shows the cost, the resulting seconds per hit, and how much Nova each 1% of damage works out at.
You can change your Nova levels straight from the calculator, so you do not have to keep switching to the Nova Shop and back. They are the same numbers, not a copy.
Pickaxe level starts at whatever Pickaxe Mastery keeps for you and your Astromech companion's levels are read from your Base, and you can override either.
Multi Crit is shown as locked until you have the Critical Chance rank it needs, with the extra cost spelled out, so it cannot be recommended before you can actually buy it.
Rebirth critical buffs are not included yet. If you know what they are, please post them in the Discord and they will be added.

notes.title: Base map
notes.summary: See your Base as an overhead map of the building, with each droid sitting on the spot it actually occupies.
changes: Added a Map button on Base that swaps the slot list for an overhead map of the base.
Slots work the same on the map: click an empty one to add a droid, and hover a droid for the usual quality, lock, swap and remove buttons.
You can drag droids between slots on the map just like the normal view.
Added an upstairs and downstairs toggle, since the Firing Range Battle slots are split across two floors.
This is a work in progress and some slots may not unlock the right spot yet.

notes.title: Mobile profiles and stability fixes
notes.summary: Account controls are now easy to reach on mobile, with steadier timers and reliable shared-profile optimisation.
changes: Added an account and profile button to the Modern mobile header, giving quick access to sign in, account creation and profile switching at every phone width.
Stopped compact spawn timers flickering between their large and small layouts near the scroll threshold.
Fixed Apply optimised layout on editable group profiles so the new layout is saved back to the shared profile.

notes.title: Command Deck UI, Stellar droids and Cycle 5
notes.summary: A complete Modern interface joins the classic Legacy view, alongside Stellar droids, 35-level rebirth cycles, Crit Pack support and new Nova upgrades.
changes: Added the Command Deck interface across Droid Archives, with a responsive navigation deck, clearer page layouts, compact spawn timers, improved Base controls and refreshed droid-slot actions.
Added a Modern / Legacy switch so you can use the redesigned interface or return to the original layout at any time.
Added Stellar as the new quality above Galactic, including the new Stellar droid artwork, production data, sell values, upgrade costs and Upgrade Chip Station output.
Extended every Super Rebirth cycle from 30 to 35 rebirths and added the complete Cycle 5 guide. Stellar droids also satisfy Galactic and every lower-quality rebirth requirement.
Removed the retired Beskar spawn timer from display while keeping its timer slot ready for a future Stellar schedule, and updated the Galactic spawn artwork.
Added Crit Pack to the Cantina Shop. Owning it grants at least 4 Critical Chance levels, 2 Critical Amount levels and 1 Multi Crit level without preventing further upgrades.
Added Chip Sell Bonus and Credit Sell Bonus to the Nova Shop, including all costs and level rewards. Chip Sell Bonus is included in the Base Upgrade Chip sell calculator.
Updated the Base layout, collapsible settings, active calculator buttons, slot locks, station arrangement and droid management controls for a cleaner and more consistent experience.
Updated upgrade paths and calculations for Galactic to Stellar, including 180 Common, 750 Rare, 8,000 Epic, 24,000 Legendary and 90,000 Mythic Upgrade Chips.

notes.title: Connected account groups and shared Rebirth Outlooks
notes.summary: Connect accounts, share selected profiles safely, and track several Rebirth Outlooks together from the Base page.
changes: Create or join account groups with an invite code, then share only the profiles you choose.
Group owners must approve new join requests before those accounts can access the group or its shared profiles.
Shared profiles are read only unless their owner explicitly allows editing.
Choose exactly which connected profiles appear in Group Rebirth Outlook, with a separate Base-page button to show or hide the panel.
Invite codes stay concealed until hovered on desktop or tapped on mobile; clicking or tapping also copies the code.
Fixed View and View / Edit freezing the page when opening another account's shared profile.

notes.title: Easier Optimise steps and quicker droid picking
notes.summary: Steps are colour-coded and tickable, sell steps can be waved off, and search boxes are ready to type in the moment they open.
changes: Step actions are colour-coded so Sell and Send cannot be mistaken for each other: red to sell, amber to move into storage, green to put to work.
Every step has a tick box so you can mark off what you have done and work through them in your own order. Ticks are remembered if you reload.
Sell steps have a Keep button. Press it and that droid is stored instead of sold, and the rest of the plan is worked out again around it.
When there is nothing worth changing, Optimise simply says Already optimal instead of offering a layout to apply.
Search boxes are focused as soon as a picker opens. Enter picks the top result and Escape closes it.
Adding a droid reopens the picker on the next free slot in that station, so filling a station is one run rather than reopening the menu each time.
The Rebirth outlook now shows where you already have each droid the next rebirth needs.

notes.title: Firing Range second floor and Multi Crit
notes.summary: Six more Battle slots open up across Rebirth 17 to 22, and Multi Crit has arrived in the Nova Shop.
changes: Added the Firing Range second floor: six new Battle Droid slots unlocking at Rebirth 17, 18, 19, 20, 21 and 22, taking the station from 5 slots to 11.
The new slots work exactly like every other Rebirth slot, so they are bought individually, respect auto purchase, and are included in Optimise and the Droid Calc.
Base and Optimise show a Second Floor divider above the new slots, matching the Lounge's Upper Level.
Added Multi Crit to the Nova Shop: four levels at 400, 800, 1,200 and 1,600 Nova, 4,000 Nova in total, requiring Critical Chance level 8.
Multi Crit allows up to five total Critical hits, with each successful additional roll halving the next roll chance.

notes.title: Droidex tracking, Companion picks and Build completion
notes.summary: The Droidex fills itself as you play, Optimise keeps your Companion slots stocked, and Build slots have to be marked complete.
changes: Adding a droid records it in your Droidex, and upgrading records every quality it passes through, so Standard to Beskar fills Gold, Diamond and Rainbow too.
Optimise can keep droids that would complete Droidex entries instead of selling them, and now tells you whether a droid is being kept for Rebirth, the Droidex or as a Companion.
Optimise keeps your Companion slots filled with the boosts you choose: highest pickaxe level, craft speed or max health. Pick one and both slots use it, pick two and you get one of each.
You can nominate preferred Iconic companions. Optimise slots them in if you own them, or tells you to go and buy them if you do not.
Build slots show red until you press Complete. Unfinished builds stay out of the Droidex and Optimise will not try to move them. There is an auto complete option if you would rather skip the step.

notes.title: Worker crafting speeds
notes.summary: Worker droids now show their real crafting speed instead of a general description.
changes: Every Worker droid shows its exact Droid Crafting speed, from +0.2/sec for a Common Standard up to +2/sec for a Mythic Galactic.

notes.title: Chopper added
notes.summary: Chopper is now in the Archives.
changes: Added Chopper, an Iconic Astromech that produces 15%/s and gives +50% Crit Chance & Damage.

notes.title: Upgrade Chip sell values
notes.summary: See what every droid is worth in Upgrade Chips and what your whole roster would fetch.
changes: Every droid page shows what it sells for in Upgrade Chips. Standard quality and Iconics are worth nothing.
A new Base panel totals what your roster would fetch, holding back the droids your next rebirth needs, including any you are still upgrading.
Every total is also shown doubled for having BB-8 as your companion.
It tells you how many chips you still need for the next rebirth and what is left owing once everything is sold.

notes.title: Optimise route planning
notes.summary: Optimise now plans one walk around the base instead of sending you back and forth between the same stations.
changes: Optimise steps are grouped by where each droid currently is, so you clear a station in one visit instead of returning to it several times.
Selling is done as you pass each station rather than as a separate lap of the base before anything else moves.
The Upgrade Chip slot is now filled with the best remaining droid for chips; previously it was often left empty.
Admittedly used AI to create the new optimiser.

notes.title: Cloud profile sync protection
notes.summary: Fixed a cloud-sync failure that could replace a multi-profile account with a new Main profile.
changes: Missing, empty, or malformed cloud responses now stop synchronization instead of creating and uploading a replacement Main profile.
Added revision checks so an outdated tab or device cannot overwrite changes saved by a newer session.
Cloud saves are blocked if profiles disappear unexpectedly; reducing the profile count is allowed only through the confirmed Delete action.
The last successfully loaded cloud document is retained locally as an additional recovery copy.
Supabase now keeps a baseline snapshot and the previous complete profile document before every cloud update or deletion.
Token refresh events no longer reload profile data over unsaved changes.

notes.title: Cantina Shop and Nova expansion
notes.summary: Added the new Cantina Shop, released new Nova perks and stations, expanded Base locking, and applied the 1.23 Upgrade Chip balance changes.
changes: Added a Cantina Shop reference with Boosts, Packs, and Surges, including V-Bucks prices, Nova Crystal token costs, durations, and full effects.
Added Second Companion, Daily Crystals, and Upgrade Chip Station to Nova Shop Featured with their current Nova Crystal costs.
Added Luck Boost, Crafting Boost, Rainbow Surge, Beskar Surge, and Galactic Surge tokens to the new Nova Shop Lobby Boosts category.
Added ownership tracking for Companion, VIP, and Starter Packs; owned packs automatically track their included Nova Shop perks.

Added a Nova-gated second Companion slot and Upgrade Chip Station to Base and Optimise. The Upgrade Chip Station produces Upgrade Chips rather than credits, works online only, and stores up to one hour of production.
Added a lock to every occupied droid slot. Locked droids remain pinned to their exact station and slot when using Optimise.
Updated Epic, Legendary, and Mythic Upgrade Chip costs to the new 1.23 values.
Saved Cantina Pack ownership and slot locks with profiles, cloud saves, imports, and exports, including migration of existing Companion locks.

notes.title: Iconic income correction
notes.summary: Iconic percentages were being added to every other droid's earnings. They are only what the Iconic droid itself earns.
changes: Base cards now show a droid's own rate: base income × multiplier, plus the ×1.10 station match when its type fits the station.
Iconic cards still show their percentage of your total base income, which remains their whole contribution.
Droid Calc and Compare droids show the same own-rate figures, so per-droid values now add up to your Base income.
Replacement thresholds, gains per hour, Lucky value, and Optimise still account for the extra Iconic share a higher base income earns.

notes.title: Compact Base cards and Scrap projections
notes.summary: Added a streamlined Base view and expanded Scrap earnings throughout the planning tools.
changes: Added a Show Detail / Hide Detail control that condenses Base cards to their image, variant-coloured name, and useful Rebirth status.
Optimise now previews the resulting Scrap payout per hit and break, including the increase over the current Base.
Detailed Droid Calc results now show the Scrap payout gained per hit and break for every replacement.
Added quality controls to owned droids in the Rebirth upgrade-efficiency list so upgrades can be recorded without returning to Base.

notes.title: Manual tracker cycle selector
notes.summary: I forgot to include a Super Rebirth Cycle selector when adding the manual Rebirth tracker.
changes: Added a Super Rebirth Cycle selector to Your outlook whenever Not using Base is enabled.

notes.title: Manual Rebirth tracker
notes.summary: Added an optional Rebirth tracker for players who do not use the Base planner.
changes: Added a Not using Base option to the Rebirth outlook so progress can be tracked independently of Base and Droidex ownership.
Each Rebirth requirement now has styled Default, Gold, Diamond, Rainbow, Beskar, and Galactic quality selectors in manual tracking mode.
Selecting a quality shows the Upgrade Chip cost needed to reach that Rebirth's required quality.
Added individual droid checkboxes for marking requirements as owned regardless of selected quality.
Added a Complete rebirth checkbox to every Rebirth heading for checking or clearing all three requirements together.
Manual Rebirth progress is saved per profile and included in local saves, cloud saves, imports, and exports.

notes.title: Rebirth slot purchases
notes.summary: Rebirth-unlocked stations now track whether each slot has actually been purchased.
changes: Reaching a slot's required rebirth now reveals a Purchase slot button instead of activating it immediately.
Added an Auto purchase slots setting, enabled by default, which purchases newly eligible slots whenever the selected rebirth changes.
Unpurchased slots are excluded from Base capacity, placements, and Optimise until purchased.
Slot purchases and the automatic-purchase preference are saved per profile and included in cloud saves, imports, and exports.
Super Rebirth now resets purchased rebirth slots while retaining the automatic-purchase preference.
Corrected Scrap Value level scaling so higher upgrade levels use their proper seconds of Base generation.

notes.title: Smarter Base and planning tools
notes.summary: Expanded the replacement, comparison, Rebirth, Lucky Droid, and Base optimisation tools.
changes: Base now automatically checks the weakest eligible productive droid instead of asking you to select a target.
Added a collapsible Base Health Check and a dedicated Droid Calc page where any productive card can still be selected manually.
Replacement results now show only the first quality of each droid that improves the target, with a plus sign when higher qualities also qualify.
Added Compact and Detailed result views, sorting choices, and an optional Minimum improvement filter that is off by default.
Clarified Worker, Astromech, and Battle break-even values so each candidate correctly accounts for the 10% station match bonus.
Added Compare buttons to individual droid wiki pages and Droidex cards.
Added cheapest upgrade-path recommendations for missing Rebirth requirements using credit gain per upgrade chip.
Added Lucky Droid practicality filters for already owned, needs upgrading, and missing droids.
Updated recommendation wording to reflect that droids are randomly obtained from quests, missions, and the conveyor belt rather than directly purchased.
Improved Optimise step instructions to use newly emptied productive slots before suggesting swaps, avoiding unnecessary trips through Build stations.
Moved Optimise directly below Base, placed View Rebirths inside the Next Rebirth panel, removed Droidex transfer controls, shortened the Base transfer button, and moved Patch Notes to a header icon.

notes.title: Community links and support
notes.summary: Added easier ways to join the community or optionally support Droid Archives.
changes: Added compact Discord and Donate buttons to the site header.
Added a separate, understated donation page with a Buy Me a Coffee link and QR code. Donations are optional support only and provide no rewards or benefits.
Retired Galactic Reports from public navigation while keeping the reporting system ready for a future variant.

notes.title: Safer Build-slot optimisation
notes.summary: Added a sell priority that frees Build slots without sacrificing droids still needed for the selected Super Rebirth Goal.
changes: Added No further use, lowest earnings as a third Keep Build slots open sell priority.
This priority only sells droids with no remaining Rebirth use inside the selected Super Rebirth Goal, starting with the lowest earners.
Future-use droids are preserved when Lounge, Companion, and other safe storage are full, even if that means a Build slot remains occupied.
Added hover help and visible descriptions explaining the behavior and tradeoffs of every sell priority.
Saved the new priority across local profiles, Supabase profiles, exports, and imports.

todo.text: Add a no-further-use sell priority and explain every Build-slot optimisation mode.

notes.title: Public Patch Notes page
notes.summary: Replaced the public To Do List with a complete, expandable release history.
changes: Replaced To Do List in the main navigation and sidebar with Patch Notes.
Added a release-history page where each update can be selected to reveal its complete list of changes.
Updated the What's New popup to link directly to Patch Notes.

notes.title: Galactic expansion and Nova Shop overhaul
notes.summary: Expanded Droid Archives with complete Galactic imagery, Rebirths 28-30, refreshed droid data, and a rebuilt Nova Shop reference.
changes: Added Galactic portraits for every non-Iconic droid, along with the missing Beskar portraits, all Mythic variant portraits, and the complete Mono-Walker portrait set.
Added Galactic production data and crafting times to droid records and individual wiki pages.
Added Rebirths 28-30 to all four Super Rebirth cycles, including their droid requirements, credit costs, Nova Crystal rewards, and multipliers.
Added Beskar to Galactic Upgrade Chip costs for Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic droids.
Rebuilt the Nova Shop with proper upgrade icons, current level costs and rewards, prerequisites, unlimited-level formulas, and Iconic Droid Nova Crystal prices.
Added a responsive Nova Shop layout with category navigation, upgrade selection, progress controls, and detailed level tables.
Closed Galactic Reports after receiving every value needed and added a thank-you message for contributors.
Fixed malformed quantity and requirement text in the Base roster and droid pickers.

todo.id: Complete Galactic and Nova data refresh
todo.text: Add Galactic images and data, Rebirths 28-30, upgrade costs, and the rebuilt Nova Shop.

notes.title: Responsive layout improvements
notes.summary: Improved layout consistency across desktop and mobile views.
changes: Kept the Droidex search field at a consistent width when switching quality tiers.
Fixed the compact spawn timers widening and clipping pages on mobile screens.
Improved mobile layouts for filters, action bars, cards, tables, modals, and helper panels across the archive.
Kept desktop layouts as the primary presentation while adding targeted narrow-screen breakpoints.

todo.text: Review the full archive for desktop consistency and mobile usability.

notes.title: Persistent Droidex filters
notes.summary: Added persistent collection filters for finding missing and non-flawless droids.
changes: Changed Missing only into a toggle that remains active across Droidex tiers and page visits.
Added a Non-flawless only toggle for finding droids that can still be marked flawless.
Both filters can be enabled together and their choices are remembered on the device.

todo.text: Add persistent Missing only and Non-flawless only toggles to Droidex.

notes.title: Collapsible Base panels
notes.summary: Added collapse controls for the larger Base helper panels.
changes: Made the Scrap calculator hideable on Base.
Made the Base Rebirth outlook collapsible.
Collapsed panel choices are remembered on the device.

todo.text: Add collapse controls for the Scrap calculator and Rebirth outlook panels.

notes.title: Galactic report modal
notes.summary: Updated Galactic Reports so players can submit several values at once with proof links.
changes: Changed Galactic Reports from an inline form to a popup with a searchable droid picker.
Added multi-droid submissions so one report can include several Buy Cost or Earn Amount values.
Added optional screenshot proof links, limited to Gyazo or Discord image links.
Blocked Imgur proof links with a note that Imgur is blocked in the UK.

todo.text: Make Galactic Reports use a popup picker with multiple rows and screenshot proof links.

notes.title: Galactic Reports
notes.summary: Added a community report page for Galactic droid costs and earn amounts.
changes: Added a Galactic Reports tab where players can submit Buy Cost or Earn Amount values for non-Iconic droids.
Inputs accept full numbers and shorthand values, such as 12400 or 12.4k.
Signed-in players only see their own submissions, while the admin can view, edit, and delete all reports.
Added moderator support so trusted users can view the full report list without edit controls.

todo.text: Add Galactic droid cost and income reporting with admin and moderator views.

notes.title: Galactic variants and Nova Featured
notes.summary: Added Galactic quality support, updated spawn timers, and added the new Nova Shop Featured upgrades.
changes: Added Galactic as a new quality above Beskar for all non-Iconic droids.
Galactic droid costs and income are shown as Coming Soon until the values are confirmed.
Rebirth checks now treat Galactic as valid for Beskar and lower quality requirements.
Added a Nova Shop Featured tab with Critical Chance, Critical Amount, and Companion Slot.
Critical Chance and Critical Amount are tracked as uncapped upgrades with known first costs of 60 and 30 Nova Crystals.
Replaced the Rainbow spawn timer with a Galactic Coming Soon timer and updated Beskar to every 15 minutes.
Iconic droids now add to Base as Default without asking for a variant.

todo.text: Add Galactic variant support, Nova Featured upgrades, timer updates, and Iconic default-only adding.

notes.title: Rebirth and credit display polish
notes.summary: Improved Rebirth planning displays and fixed a random scroll jump.
changes: Added a Rebirth page toggle for showing or hiding completed rebirths.
Base Rebirth Outlook now shows the next rebirth, its credit cost, and the droids required.
Needed later in this cycle now shows credit costs beside each rebirth heading.
Credit amounts now use the local Credits icon.
Rarity badges on Droids and Droidex pages now use their proper rarity colours.
Fixed the page randomly jumping back to the top during same-page updates.

notes.title: Rebirth goal planning
notes.summary: Added a Super Rebirth Goal setting and a full Rebirth guide page.
changes: Added Super Rebirth Goal so Base, Optimise, and recommendations stop caring about rebirths past your chosen target.
Added a Rebirth page showing every rebirth requirement in the selected cycle, even past your current goal.
Added a Base outlook box that highlights ready rebirths and the rarities/variants still worth watching for.
Renamed BU-4D to B-U4D and added coloured rarity labels across the archive.

notes.title: Lucky Droid rarity chances
notes.summary: Lucky Droid recommendations now include Mythics and score upgrades by their rarity-based success chance.
changes: Added Mythic droids to Lucky Droid recommendations.
Lucky upgrade odds are now Common 32%, Rare 16%, Epic 8%, Legendary 4%, and Mythic 2%.
Rebirth and Credit recommendations now rank by expected value instead of using one flat chance.

notes.summary: C-3PO has been added as a new iconic Worker droid.
changes: Added C-3PO as an iconic Worker droid.
C-3PO provides 25%/s income while placed in a productive station.
Added his Companion passive: 2x Droid Sell Value.
Added support for update popups and patch notes.

notes.title: Lucky Droid recommendations
notes.summary: Added a Lucky Droid Recommendation page for choosing the best daily 4% upgrade gamble.
changes: Added a Lucky Droid tab to the top navigation and sidebar.
Added Rebirth based recommendations that prioritise future rebirth progress and upgrade-chip savings.
Added Credit based recommendations that prioritise the biggest credits-per-hour gain.
Each recommendation can be clicked for a breakdown of why it was chosen.
